Connection-shared artifacts also require the connection feature gate. Atomically commits placement and sidebar order: spaces prepends, library removes, and repeating the current placement preserves order. Content, identity, capabilities, pinning, and recency are preserved. Returns the committed request as a receipt; consume the existing placement-scoped artifact and Navigation subscriptions and re-fetch tab order for current state. Stale or missing identity returns 409 artifact_changed; a full sidebar returns 400 sidebar_full. Malformed or unsupported references and malformed body fields return 400 invalid_params.
